login.heading: Sign in to the admin app
login.intro: Use your BeekeepingIT account to manage your organization, members and roles.
login.accountNote: Account and password are managed at your identity provider.

orgSettings.heading: Organization details
orgSettings.intro: Update your organization's name and address. Changes apply to everyone in the organization.

conflict.body: Someone else changed this organization while you were editing. Reload to get the latest details, then apply your changes again.

errors.nameTooLong: Organization name must be at most {{max}} characters.
errors.addressTooLong: Address must be at most {{max}} characters.
errors.saveFailed: We could not save your changes. Please try again.
errors.loadFailed: We could not load your organization. Please try again.
errors.versionUnavailable: We could not confirm the current version of your organization, so we did not save to avoid overwriting someone else's changes. Please reload and try again.

denied.heading: Admin access required
denied.body: Your account does not have the admin role in this organization, so you cannot use the admin app. Ask an organization admin to grant you the admin role, then sign in again.
denied.noOrg: Your account is not a member of any organization yet. Join or create an organization in the field app first.

error.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

config.heading: Configuration error
config.body: The admin app is missing required configuration. Set the following environment variables and rebuild:
